frozen_before: any implementation of stage 1 and any timed run
source: specs/021-simulator-as-domain-client/spec.md, section 'Решения консультации T2100 (2026-09-27)', item 'Пороги приёмки' - copied verbatim; these are acceptance budgets, not measured results
rule: A failed threshold is recorded and stage 1 stops for narrowing or a dated reconsideration. A threshold is never moved after the first timed run, and failed samples are never averaged with passing ones.

checkpoint_computations.verbatim: Exactly `2 × touched_equivalents` checkpoint computations per successful nonempty batch, independent of edge count.
checkpoint_computations.applies_to: every successful batch with at least one applied operation

sql_statements.verbatim: At most `16 × applied_operations + 20 × touched_equivalents + 20` client SQL statements for the measured trust-line batch.
sql_statements.applies_to: every measured batch, empty ones included (applied_operations = touched_equivalents = 0 gives a budget of 20)
sql_statements.counted_as: SQLAlchemy before_cursor_execute events on the batch's engine, from the start of the batch call through its commit

seed_p95_seconds.verbatim: Seed benchmark: p95 ≤ **5 seconds** for the specified 100-participant/523-line community on the recorded local PostgreSQL stand.

run.verbatim: Прогон: одинаковые нагрузки до и после на свежих изолированных базах, фиксированные входы, ≥ 20 замеров после прогрева; записываются число SQL, число контрольных точек, p50/p95 и исходы откатов; в замер входят пакеты роста и затухания и повторное сидирование.
run.percentile: nearest-rank over the samples after warm-up

inputs.community_sha256_history: 2026-10-04, 028 F-028-29 (owner В-2, migration 035): the nine `frozen` lines of the description became `active` (their creditors are the frozen participants); measured on 3378074e79a8518d0eeecf4a5862aee93d1b9fd817c97e1072934decfcc6a457 until then
inputs.scenario_mapping: participants -> {id: pid, name, type, status}; trustlines -> {from: pid of ref, to: pid of ref, equivalent, limit, status, policy}; equivalents -> codes; list order kept

workloads.seed: RealScenarioSeeder.seed_scenario_into_db on a fresh migrated empty database, then commit
workloads.reseed: the same seeding call on a fresh copy of the seeded database, then commit

growth.call: TrustDriftEngine.apply_trust_growth (commits itself) on a fresh copy of the seeded database
growth.selection: the first 50 active UAH lines in community order

decay.call: RealTickTrustDriftCoordinator.apply_trust_decay_and_broadcast (commits the decay) on a fresh copy of the seeded database
decay.selection: the first 25 active lines of each equivalent in community order

rollback_probes.what: one run per workload with a non-database failure raised after the first mutation of the transaction; recorded: persisted limit/status of the first mutated line and the number of trust-line audit rows after the owner's handling and a later commit on the same session
rollback_probes.failure_point_before: a RuntimeError raised by a statement hook right after the first trust-line write statement of the transaction has executed (the current code computes no checkpoint)
rollback_probes.failure_point_after: a RuntimeError raised by the first after-mutation checkpoint computation of the transaction
